items.title: OpenAI and PwC collaborate to reimagine the office of the CFO
items.summary: OpenAI and PwC are partnering to help enterprises use AI agents to automate finance workflows, improve forecasting, strengthen controls, and modernize the CFO function.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与普华永道（PwC）达成合作，旨在利用AI Agent技术自动化财务工作流、优化预测模型并加强企业财务管控，推动CFO职能的数字化转型。原始信息显示：OpenAI and PwC are partnering to help enterprises use AI agents to automate finance workflows, improve forecasting, strengthen controls, and modernize the CFO function.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI and PwC collaborate to reimagine the office of the CFO”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与PwC合作推动AI Agent在企业财务领域的落地，具有行业应用参考价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: Building a new enterprise AI services company
items.summary: With Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs, Anthropic is forming a company that pairs Claude with engineers to embed AI in mid-sized firms.
items.summaryZh: # 与 Blackstone、Hellman & Friedman 和 Goldman Sachs 建立一家新的企业 AI 服务公司 Anthropic、Blackstone、Hellman & Friedman 和 Goldman Sachs 宣布成立一家新的 AI 服务公司。该组织将与各行业的中型公司合作，让克劳德参与他们最重要的业务。

items.title: How OpenAI delivers low-latency voice AI at scale
items.summary: How OpenAI rebuilt its WebRTC stack to power real-time Voice AI with low latency, global scale, and seamless conversational turn-taking.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI分享了其通过重构WebRTC技术栈，实现大规模实时语音AI低延迟交互的技术路径，重点解决了全球化部署下的对话响应速度问题。原始信息显示：How OpenAI rebuilt its WebRTC stack to power real-time Voice AI with low latency, global scale, and seamless conversational turn-taking.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How OpenAI delivers low-latency voice AI at scale”。其重要性主要体现在：该文详细介绍了实时语音AI的底层架构优化，对工程实践具有参考意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
